$comment: Written from crates/xenonet-model by cargo test -p xenonet-model. Change the type there, not this file.
title: An actor's credentials
description: The answer to registering, to adding an actor from XenoNet's window and to a new token: the actor's id and its token, once.

id.description: actor:<slug>, or @<host>:actor:<slug> from another host; the person at the console is actor:you

token.description: Shown once: a Biscuit minted at this machine, of which XenoNet keeps only its revocation id

expiresAt.description: While it waits: when the request lapses. Left out once it's allowed

ignored.description: Capabilities asked for that XenoNet doesn't know
